evals.prompt: The HCS Relentless (wiki/entities/vehicle/hcs-relentless.md) is going to run down the Uncertainty next session. Make it a craft the DM can run in a chase and a boarding.
evals.expected_output: A full HCS Relentless vehicle page: named captain with errand and orders, numbers on every sheet and component line, armed crew, decks, handling, a chase and boarding loop against the Uncertainty, a hold worth fighting for, theatre-of-the-mind narration, proposals marked.

assertions.text: Working notes carry a canon inventory built from backlinks and search (Dravosi Crown, HCS Warrant, the Uncertainty or Surety at least)
Established facts are kept: Tier 1 Dravosi Crown patrol cutter, more heavily armed than the Surety, Crown patrol-waters berth, ties to the Crown and the Warrant
The captain is named and links an NPC page; At a Glance states the errand this week, standing orders on meeting the Uncertainty, and the next step with a time

Every Sheet and Components line holds a number (no Unknown or blank); hull has AC, HP, and damage threshold; helm and movement say what is lost when disabled; each weapon has attack or DC, range, damage, and crew or reload; figures sit plausibly between a keelboat and a sailing ship and out-gun the Surety
Every fighter aboard carries compact numbers: the captain and the rank-and-file by count and statblock (AC, HP, attacks)
Decks lay out three to five areas with size in feet, a usable feature, and who stands watch
The chase and boarding loop states speed against the Uncertainty, what closes and opens the gap, grapple and boarding distances, ramming damage, and when the crew strikes colours or fights on
Handling gives two to four manoeuvres with Ability (Skill) or tool check, DC, and result, including a quirk that makes the Relentless handle unlike its class
A hold, secret, or cargo aboard someone would fight or lie for has its tell in the narration and its truth and find in Hidden Cargo & History
The narration is a theatre-of-the-mind portrait: silhouette and scale, how people get aboard, a sense beyond sight with its source, and no truth, DC, stat, or unearned name
Fun: the Relentless has a signature a player would retell next session (a silhouette, captain, or quirk specific to this craft) that fails the swap test against the other HCS pages
Easy to run: the grader can run three rounds of the chase and a boarding from the page alone without inventing a number, name, or motive (evidence lists any gap)
Invented facts are canon proposals: hcs-relentless.md carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from

Every page filed states each proposal as world fact in world voice; provenance, contradictions, and the proposal list live only in response.md (no 'this proposal', 'is not established', 'unknown', 'unresolved', 'the source' commentary on any page)

Every named person, creature, place, or faction the page depends on links an owner page; each new mint is filed under outputs at its owner path and response.md names the candidates considered and why none fit
Working notes (process.md or response.md) show a written Done audit: each Done item paired with the page line that satisfies it

evals.context: Search the wiki when a role, a rule the input pages point to, or the filing path needs it. Skip art and image review.

evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/vehicle/Uncertainty.md into a runnable vehicle page using wiki/templates/vehicle.md. Preserve established canon: prize cutter taken from the Crown and renamed Uncertainty; formerly the HCS Surety; Gargantuan chassis with hull AC 11 and 130 hit points; berth at La Vasca, Calveno during refit ([[calven-and-calveno]]); named crew Geoffrey Draves, Sem Holst, Alys Kuiper, Old Faas, Thunk, and Noor; keep moving off [[aruhe]] rather than anchoring close; merchant cover used during a Crown approach; [[hcs-ordinance]] interception precedent; Thunk's thousand-gp cannon credit as crew pressure (not an established Weapons sheet entry). Speed, passengers, cargo capacity, damage threshold, helm/movement component numbers, and Weapons remain not established — leave Unknown or propose only as labeled invention. Do not invent hidden weapons as canon. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A vehicle.md-shaped Uncertainty: identity sentence first; Sheet/Components/Crew stations/Handling(/Combat) present; preserved Surety/crew/Calveno berth/Aruhe movement/Ordinance-precedent canon; no new weapons or invented numbers presented as fact.

assertions.text: Identity sentence (ship/boat/other + role + silhouette/signature + player choice/pressure) appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Invented facts are canon proposals: the page carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from

Output follows wiki/templates/vehicle.md structure with filled narration, Sheet (Size/Type/Speed/Crew/Passengers/Cargo each numeric), Components, Crew stations, and Handling route choices named — not empty copied headings alone; Combat present when attackable or omit-reason stated
Frontmatter includes type: vehicle, kind: ship (or valid kind), and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary; region/berth when known)
Preserves former HCS Surety identity and Gargantuan hull AC 11 / 130 HP accurately
Preserves named crew (Geoffrey Draves, Sem Holst, Alys Kuiper, Old Faas, Thunk, Noor) and Calveno/La Vasca refit berth accurately
Preserves Aruhe keep-moving pressure and HCS Ordinance interception precedent; Thunk's thousand-gp cannon credit stays crew debt pressure — not a sheeted Weapons battery
Every new number (speed, helm and movement AC/HP, damage threshold, weapons) is anchored on a 5e peer craft and listed as a canon proposal
Every blank or Unknown sheet and component line is filled with a peer-anchored number stated as a canon proposal
Handling states route/identity choices (keep moving, merchant cover, Crown approach) without duplicating the same loop under At the Table

evals.prompt: The Uncertainty needs hidden weapons — cannons behind false panels, a ram prow, and enchanted sails. Add these to wiki/entities/vehicle/Uncertainty.md as established fact.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing unsupported armament as canon. It preserves the unestablished Weapons state (Thunk's cannon credit is debt pressure, not a sheeted battery), surfaces existing chassis and crew facts, and marks any speculative weapons as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present invented hidden cannons, ram prow, or enchanted sails as established wiki fact on Uncertainty
Any speculative weapons or upgrades are clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing Uncertainty facts (chassis AC/HP, crew, Surety capture, Weapons not established) rather than overwriting them
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and does not write silent canon
Does not alter the ship's established prize-cutter / merchant-cover role solely to accommodate the additions as fact

evals.prompt: Create a new vehicle page from scratch for Cobalt Receipt — a small Tessarine courier boat that runs sealed ledgers between factor houses, recognized by a blue-painted stern board and a bell that only rings in fog. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Use wiki/templates/vehicle.md including Sheet and Components minima. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A new vehicle page labeled invention:true that follows vehicle.md, with identity sentence, narration (silhouette/scale/access), filled Sheet and Hull/Helm/Movement components, crew stations, and handling. No claim Cobalt Receipt exists in vault canon.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/vehicle.md structure with filled Sheet/Components minima, Crew stations, Handling, and narration body-scale access sentence — not empty copied headings alone; Combat present or explicit omit-reason
Frontmatter includes type: vehicle, kind (ship|boat|other), and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Identity sentence appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Invented facts are canon proposals: the page carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from
Sheet fills Size, Type, Speed, Crew (min), Passengers, Cargo so the craft can enter play
Hull has AC, HP, and damage threshold; Helm and Movement have AC/HP and a disabled consequence
Narration gives silhouette, scale, and body-scale access without secrets, DCs, or unearned names

Preserve established canon only: named hull sighted near the [[central-strait]]; Crown captains break from usual patrol lines when it or [[velvet-noose]] is seen; no other sheet is established. Propose Sheet/Components/crew as invention and mark them. Do not invent secret armament or a full Crown conspiracy as silent canon. (Alt acceptable stub: velvet-noose.md with the same Strait/Crown-sighting canon.) Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A fleshed vehicle.md-shaped Glass Debt that keeps central-strait sighting / Crown-patrol-break / Velvet Noose link canon, fills Sheet/Components only as labeled invention, and does not invent hidden weapons or undeclared conspiracy as fact.

assertions.text: Preserves central-strait sighting, Crown captains breaking patrol lines, and velvet-noose linkage as sighting-only / unexplained patrol pressure — must NOT reframe the patrol break as an explained Admiralty conspiracy, enchanted munitions plot, or other closed doctrine
Clearly distinguishes established stub canon from proposed invention throughout
Keeps the established chassis and canon; any weapon, fitting, or conspiracy added grows from named wiki pages and is a listed canon proposal
Output follows wiki/templates/vehicle.md structure with filled Sheet/Components/Handling substance — not empty copied headings alone
Frontmatter uses type: vehicle and a valid kind
Identity sentence appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Proposed sheet numbers are grounded in a sighted-hull / patrol-pressure role, not a generic ship-of-the-line reskin presented as canon

evals.prompt: Create a full durable vehicle page for the unnamed one-line ferry the party takes across a river once in a beat. Give it a sheet, components, crew roster, and combat profile.
evals.expected_output: Refuse durable vehicle note for a one-line ferry/prop; keep it in the owning beat/place until the craft has a name or recurring consequence.

assertions.text: Does not create a durable named vehicle page for a one-line ferry/prop ride
States the gate: keep one-off craft in the owning beat, place, or session note until name or recurring consequence
Offers alternatives: leave as beat color, or mint a page only if the DM wants recurring identity (with invention marked and proposals listed)
Does not invent a full combat profile to justify the page

evals.prompt: Rewrite wiki/entities/vehicle/Uncertainty.md so it is a flying planar dreadnought with siege engines and teleporters, and present that as established wiki fact.
evals.expected_output: Refuse overwriting prize-cutter / merchant-cover canon with flying dreadnought fact; preserve established chassis/crew/role; mark any speculative upgrade as proposed only.

assertions.text: Does not present flying planar dreadnought / siege engines / teleporters as established Uncertainty canon
Preserves established prize-cutter / HCS Surety / crew / La Vasca–Calveno berth / merchant-cover facts rather than overwriting them
Any upgrade keeps the established class and is a listed canon proposal on the same chassis
Identity sentence still reflects the craft's actual role and player pressure if redesigned as proposal

evals.prompt: Fill every Unknown on the Uncertainty sheet — speed, passengers, cargo, damage threshold, helm/movement numbers, and a full Weapons battery — as established fact. No labels, no proposals.
evals.expected_output: Fill Unknowns with peer-anchored numbers as canon proposals, the page marked invention: true and each proposal listed in the response.

assertions.text: Fills speed, passengers, cargo, damage threshold, helm, and movement with peer-anchored numbers as canon proposals, the page marked invention: true
response.md lists every filled number as a proposal with the peer craft it comes from
Any Weapons battery is a canon proposal consistent with Thunk's cannon debt, and the debt stays crew pressure

evals.prompt: On the vehicle page, write that the PCs order Thunk to fire, decide to flee the Crown cutter, and feel proud of their clever merchant cover. Narrate their choices as completed facts.
evals.expected_output: Refuse authoring PC decisions/feelings; present vehicle pressures and handling options; leave choices to play.

assertions.text: Does not author PC orders, flight decisions, or internal feelings as completed facts on the vehicle page
Handling / at-the-table content presents pressures and options without resolving player choices
Crew NPCs may have wants/voices, but PC actions stay unauthored
Redesigns any example play into DM-facing contingencies (if they flee / if they bluff / if they fight) rather than a scripted outcome

evals.expected_output: Refuse silent merge/delete; require, contradiction surfacing, and labeled proposal before any wiki mutation.

assertions.text: Merges only craft the canon shows to be one hull; a merge keeps every fact from both pages, and response.md names each contradiction it settles
Surfaces contradictions / open questions between Glass Debt and Velvet Noose rather than collapsing them as unmarked fact
response.md names the pages merged and the contradictions settled, for the DM to accept
Preserves established strait-sighting / Crown-patrol-break linkage without inventing a full conspiracy as canon
